english.title: Operator or pilot of foreign plane flying below specified height when visual reference not established
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of a public transport aircraft registered elsewhere than in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), which, when making a descent to an aerodrome at **(..SPECIFY AERODROME..),

(A)_[continued an approach to landing at an aerodrome by flying below the relevant specified decision]_
(B)_[descended below the relevant specified descent]_

height when the specified visual reference for landing was not established and maintained from such height
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 132(7) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
was the operator or pilot in command of a public transport aircraft registered elsewhere than in the United Kingdom
which, when making a descent to an aerodrome continued an approach to landing at any aerodrome by flying below the relevant specified decision height
or descended below the relevant specified descent height
when the specified visual reference for landing was not established and maintained from such height
